Negan was first teased at EVO 2018 as part of the second wave of Tekken 7 DLC characters, and was the fourth guest character to be added to the roster, after Akuma, Geese, and Noctis. He was released alongside Julia Chang on February 28, 2019 as a DLC character in Season Pass 2. Like the other two crossover DLC characters before him, he was bundled with a stage centered around his origin series, entitled Last Day on Earth.
